reference_policy.scope: Relative to Special-100 v1. Every revised public question, including the redesigned multi-record0073, has a new public-context reference; unchanged57 retain current-identity verified references.

difficulty_definition.advanced: Interacting scientific/method-domain boundaries with meaningful branches and a nontrivial scientific join; design-based, not measured baseline failure.
difficulty_definition.intermediate: A coherent multi-method comparison or dependency graph with shared evidence and an actual scientific decision.
difficulty_definition.foundation: A bounded control problem with reusable state, independent branches and a consistent scientific join. Lower effort for graph execution, not a claim that serial methods trivially solve it.

selection_policy: Every task has a scientific purpose and an explicit graph-execution mechanism.
Tool count or internal algorithm complexity alone does not establish task difficulty.
Public inputs and three metrics are shared across baselines; equivalent correct scientific routes are eligible.
No model-specific score bonus or hidden reference serial-order requirement.
Readiness and execution-safety evidence do not establish measured end-to-end speedup.
scope: Independent Special-100; neither Full-500 nor Mini-200 modified.
